_provenance.note: Generated from ICP-1.0 §5.3 replay rules and schemas/error-codes.md. Checks (precedence): replay.timestamp_malformed, replay.window_too_long (exp-iat > 600s), replay.expired (exp < now). Each case supplies a reference clock `now`. Timestamps are strict YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; epoch via days_from_civil (no leap seconds, positive years). replay.iat_in_future is deferred: §5.3 leaves the allowed clock skew unspecified (spec-clarification item).
